summary: Updated Performance Appraisal Current-State vs Future-State specification incorporating Lion International Bank real-world operational rules: 3 employee categories (Managerial 15 questions, Clerical 11 questions, Non-clerical 14 questions in Amharic), 1-5 scale, discrete conversion bands (>=4.0 -> 100%, 3.5-3.9 -> 75%, 3.0-3.49 -> 50%, <3.0 -> No Value), supervisor/branch manager double sign-off, employee digital acknowledgment, and direct linkage to Annual Bonus and Internal Vacancy competition.
